title: Glowe Raises Multi-Ten-Million RMB Series A+ from FreeS for AIGC-Assisted Therapy
summary: On Mar 2, 2023, online therapy platform Glowe (阁楼) raised multi-ten-million RMB A+ led by FreeS Fund (峰瑞). Proceeds: efficiency — especially generative models to 1–2× counselor throughput + competence.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · March 29, 2023

On Mar 2, 2023, online therapy platform Glowe (阁楼) raised multi-ten-million RMB A+ led by FreeS Fund (峰瑞). Proceeds: efficiency — especially generative models to 1–2× counselor throughput + competence.

Founded 2021 for urban youth with mild–moderate depression/anxiety; standardized CBT + IPT frameworks (rare CS-heavy team in therapy). Founder Liu Qiuyang (USC CS) prior Tell App for teens (>4M regs). Tens of thousands paying users; async + appointment model lets counselors multiplex. Not a marketplace — industrialized standardized sessions. AI as assist (memo/eval reports on GPT-3) not replacement — human connection stays core; standardized data feeds model training.

— END —
